setup-check.001:
ℹ️ Catalog abhi khali hai. Pehle products likhein, ek line mein:
"{0}"
(ya "import" se Excel file bhej dein). Apni dukaan ki qism ke examples ke liye "industry" likhein.
setup-check.002: ℹ️ {0} products ki cost price nahi likhi, is liye profit sahi nahi aayega. Likhein, jaise: "{1}". Poori list ke liye "data check" likhein.
setup-check.004: ✅ Aapka data mukammal aur theek hai — reports poori tarah kaam karengi.
setup-check.007: ⚠️ Cost price nahi: {0}/{1} products — profit/margin adhoora. Likhein, jaise: "{2}"
setup-check.009: ⚠️ Category nahi: {0}/{1} — category reports adhoori. Likhein, jaise: "{2}"
setup-check.010: ✅ Stock: sab products ka track hota hai
setup-check.011: ⚠️ Stock track nahi: {0}/{1} — reorder/dead stock nahi nikal sakta. Likhein, jaise: "stock {2} 20"
setup-check.012: ⚠️ {0} orders {1}+ din se Pending/Shipped hain — status update karein: "mark 12 delivered"
setup-check.013: ✅ Purane orders: koi atka hua nahi
setup-check.014: ✅ Kharcha: pichle 30 din ka likha hua hai
setup-check.015: ⚠️ 30 din mein koi kharcha nahi likha — net/P&L adhoora. Likhein: "expense 5000 rent"
setup-check.016: ⚠️ Dukaan ki qism set nahi — examples aur guide aap ki dukaan ke mutabiq nahi. Likhein: "industry" (phir list se chunein)
setup-check.017: ⚠️ Cost price >= sale price ({0}): {1} — shayad cost ya price ghalat likha. Theek karein: "edit product: Name - price, cost X"
setup-check.018: ⚠️ Price 0 hai ({0}): {1} — sales/profit mein 0 ginay jayenge.
setup-check.019: ⚠️ Stock minus mein ({0}): {1} — maal aane ka stock likhein: "stock {2} +10"
setup-check.020: ⚠️ Milte-julte product naam ({0}): {1} — ek hi product do dafa to nahi? Sales alag alag ginay jayengi.
setup-check.021: ⚠️ Phone ghalat ya khali ({0} customers): {1} — theek karein: "Sara ka phone 0300…"
setup-check.022: ⚠️ Ek phone, kayi naam ({0}): {1} — ek customer do dafa ban gaya? Customer history/churn reports bikhar jati hain.
setup-check.023: ⚠️ Na city na address ({0} customers): {1} — shehar-wise reports mein nahi ayenge. Likhein: "Bilal ki city Lahore"
setup-check.024: ⚠️ {0} shipped/delivered orders mein courier nahi likha (90 din) — courier-wise return/delivery time nahi nikalega. Likhein: "add tracking: Ayesha, TCS 123456"
